CWB-PERM-004..012, CWB-OTHER-008/009 and REQ-018..020 are untouched, matching deploy-order.md's own statement that Case_Tier1/Tier2/Billing and all three PermissionSetGroup files needed no edit.

Every one of the seven fieldPermissions this pass documents traces to a named source (an M1-S02 layout, an M1 milestone finding, or the F-60 Apex fixture's own field list) rather than to platform memory -- the same discipline check_access_model.py's PSVP-FLS-01 rule exists to enforce, applied one field at a time in D-M2S02-08.

It is real residual risk carried into the M2 gate, not a false positive, and no source on file names the fields needed to close it -- recorded as O-M2S02-02 rather than left implicit in a passing exit code.

F-60 reached the build at mock-deploy run 5, after five milestone verifications and two prior org dry runs on M2-S02, because nothing exercised the permission sets as the persona until an Apex test ran runAs(agent). The same unverified-persona-DML risk still stands on M2-S01's integration permission set and M2-S03's base profiles, per deploy-order.md's own Process Observations for this rebuild.

O-M2S02-02 is filed under decisions.md's 'Open items for the planner' heading alongside every other O-/D- entry in this file, but its actual audience is the milestone human gate (a compose-UI step or a clarification answer would close it), not build_plan.py's plan-text authority the way the API-version-drift open items are. Filed there anyway for consistency with this build's own established convention; a human reading the gate should not read the heading as meaning only the planner needs to see it.
